name: dedsafio
description: Launcher privado + backend + mods para el servidor Minecraft 1.21.1 (Fabric).

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run -w @dedsafio/backend dev
scripts.start:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run -w @dedsafio/backend start
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run -w @dedsafio/backend test
scripts.db:embedded: npm run build:shared && npx tsx tools/dev-db.ts
scripts.keys:generate: npm run build:shared && npx tsx tools/generate-keys.ts
scripts.mods:publish: npm run build:shared && npx tsx tools/publish-mod.ts
scripts.mods:publish-all: npm run build:shared && npx tsx tools/publish-folder.ts
scripts.mods:manifest: npm run build:shared && npx tsx tools/publish-manifest.ts
